events.event_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang departure saga continues; HSBC downgrades to Hold, target $365→$170; Renaissance Tech slashed 99.7% in Q3
events.assets: 英伟达、AMD、半导体板块、台湾加权指数、Arm
events.assets_en: Nvidia, AMD, semiconductors, Taiwan Weighted Index, Arm
events.logic: CEO不确定性→AI capex信心动摇→芯片股估值重估→台股传导（-5%）；黄仁勋盟友推动复职形成多空博弈
events.logic_en: CEO uncertainty → AI capex confidence shaken → chip stock revaluation → Taiwan spillover (-5%); allies push for reinstatement

events.event: 特朗普政府将英伟达、亚马逊、微软、OpenAI、Anthropic等20+企业列入AI"国家领军企业"名单，获芯片出口快速审批

events.assets: AI芯片出口链、上榜企业、中美科技博弈
events.assets_en: AI chip export chain, listed companies, US-China tech
events.logic: 名单内企业获出口便利→利好上榜公司海外收入；但与黄仁勋反对芯片后门的立场冲突→政策与人事矛盾并存
events.logic_en: Listed companies get export facilitation → boosts overseas revenue; but conflicts with Huang's anti-backdoor stance → policy vs personnel contradiction

events.event_en: Fed semi-annual Financial Stability Report: asset valuation pressure remains elevated, AI asset prices and investment expansion may amplify volatility; Chicago/Boston Fed presidents warn of inflation spread
events.assets: 美股估值、AI概念股、美债收益率
events.assets_en: US equity valuations, AI stocks, UST yields
events.logic: 官方点名AI估值泡沫→市场风险偏好收缩→加息预期升温（12月+25bp概率高，+50bp概率15%）→科技股承压
events.logic_en: Official AI bubble warning → risk appetite contracts → rate hike expectations rise (Dec +25bp likely, +50bp 15%) → tech pressure

events.event: 美国10月PPI同比6.5%（2022年11月以来最高），环比0.3%低于预期；财长贝森特称不应因能源冲击加息，与古尔斯比交锋

events.assets_en: US Treasuries, USD, rate hike expectations
events.logic: PPI低于预期→美债收益率短线回落；但同比仍创新高→加息预期未根本动摇；财长与联储官员公开分歧增加不确定性
events.logic_en: PPI below expectations → yields dip short-term; but YoY still record high → hike expectations unshaken; Treasury vs Fed public disagreement adds uncertainty

events.event: 布油两周跌近19%创六年多最大同期跌幅；高盛预测2027年石油"大量过剩"；IEA称四季度全球石油转向供应过剩
events.event_en: Brent falls ~19% in 2 weeks, biggest 2-week drop in 6+ years; Goldman forecasts oil 'massive surplus' in 2027; IEA says Q4 global oil shifts to surplus
events.assets: 原油、能源股、黄金（避险需求减弱）
events.assets_en: Crude oil, energy stocks, gold (safe-haven demand weakens)
events.logic: 中东原油夺回亚洲市场+供应过剩预期→油价持续下行→通胀能源分项回落→但金价同步走弱（实际利率上行压制）
events.logic_en: Middle East regains Asian market + surplus expectations → oil持续下降 → inflation energy component falls → but gold also weakens (real rates rising)

events.event: 2年期美债收益率全周升33bp创两年最大周升幅；美元指数19个月新高；日元两个多月来首次跌破160；比特币一度跌破6.8万
events.event_en: 2Y UST yield rises 33bp weekly, biggest in 2 years; Dollar Index 19-month high; JPY breaks 160 for first time in 2+ months; Bitcoin briefly below $68K
events.assets: 美债、美元、日元、新兴市场货币、比特币
events.assets_en: UST, USD, JPY, EM currencies, Bitcoin
events.logic: 加息预期飙升→美债抛售→美元走强→日元/新兴货币承压；强美元冲击全球流动性→风险资产暂难入场（美银Hartnett）
events.logic_en: Hike expectations surge → UST selloff → USD strengthens → JPY/EM currencies pressured; strong USD hits global liquidity → risk assets sidelined (BofA Hartnett)

events.event: 中国10月工业增加值同比放缓至4.8%、社零增0.4%（剔除汽车+2.5%）、地产开发投资同比-21.6%、固定资产投资-8.1%
events.event_en: China Oct industrial output YoY slows to 4.8%, retail sales +0.4% (ex-auto +2.5%), real estate investment -21.6%, fixed asset investment -8.1%
events.assets: A股、港股、人民币、大宗商品需求
events.assets_en: A-shares, HK stocks, CNY, commodity demand
events.logic: 内需弱于预期+地产持续拖累→创业板-3.32%成长股先塌→银行股逆势新高（防御切换）；但信息服务业+20.5%显示结构分化
events.logic_en: Weak domestic demand + property drag → ChiNext -3.32% growth stocks collapse → bank stocks hit new highs (defensive rotation); but IT services +20.5% shows structural divergence

events.event: 康方生物盘中大跌逾20%：依沃西美国首次上市申请未获批；恒生生物科技指数-2.5%
events.event_en: Akeso plunges 20%+ intraday: ivonescimab US first marketing application not approved; Hang Seng Biotech Index -2.5%
events.assets: 康方生物、港股生物科技、创新药ETF
events.assets_en: Akeso, HK biotech, innovative drug ETFs
events.logic: 单品出海受阻→市场质疑创新药国际化路径→板块情绪传染→生物科技整体杀估值
events.logic_en: Single drug overseas setback → market questions innovative drug internationalization path → sector sentiment contagion → biotech valuation haircut

events.event: 美国10月财政赤字4040亿创同期新高；过去12个月利息支出1.4万亿，占税收28.2%创历史新高
events.event_en: US Oct fiscal deficit $404B record high for period; trailing 12-month interest expense $1.4T, 28.2% of tax revenue - all-time high
events.assets: 美债信用、长期国债收益率、黄金（对冲财政风险）
events.assets_en: UST credit, long-term yields, gold (hedge fiscal risk)
events.logic: 赤字+利息刚性支出→发债需求上升→长期美债供给压力→但目前被强劲拍卖消化（贝森特强调买盘旺盛）
events.logic_en: Deficit + rigid interest spending → bond issuance demand rises → long-term UST supply pressure → but currently absorbed by strong auctions (Bessent emphasizes robust demand)

events.event: SpaceX-特斯拉合并谈判提速，最快12月宣布；星舰首次"双回收"测试（助推器失败、飞船回收待验证）；特斯拉开放Cybercab购买$29990
events.event_en: SpaceX-Tesla merger talks accelerate, announcement as early as Dec; Starship first 'dual recovery' test (booster failed, spacecraft recovery pending); Tesla opens Cybercab orders at $29,990
events.assets: 特斯拉、SpaceX估值、自动驾驶概念
events.assets_en: Tesla, SpaceX valuation, autonomous driving concept

events.logic_en: Merger expectation + full reuse milestone → Tesla +1.9% intraday → if completed, largest merger in history → reshapes AI+space+mobility valuation framework

chains.title: ① 英伟达CEO危机 → AI硬件估值重估链
chains.title_en: 1. Nvidia CEO Crisis → AI Hardware Revaluation Chain

jargon.explain: 市场不知道下一任掌门是谁、会不会改变AI芯片战略方向，所以先卖出避险。
jargon.explain_en: Market doesn't know who the next leader is or whether AI chip strategy changes, so sells first.

jargon.explain: 英伟达联合多家私募帮客户买GPU算力的"分期付款"方案，黄仁勋走了，兜底担保没人签了。
jargon.explain_en: Nvidia partnered with PE firms to help clients buy GPU compute on 'installments.' With Huang gone, no one signs the guarantee.

jargon.term: 剩余价值支持协议（兜底比例）
jargon.explain: 客户用完GPU后英伟达承诺回购多少比例。英伟达只兜25%，博通兜72.5%，客户觉得英伟达不够大方。
jargon.explain_en: Nvidia promises to buy back a % of used GPUs. Nvidia only guarantees 25%, Broadcom 72.5% — clients find Nvidia less generous.

jargon.explain: 美国机构每季度公布持仓，文艺复兴在丑闻爆发前就已清仓，说明"聪明钱"提前嗅到风险。
jargon.explain_en: US institutions report holdings quarterly. Renaissance cleared positions before the scandal, showing 'smart money' sensed risk early.

chains.title: ② 美联储加息预期飙升 → 强美元冲击全球流动性链
chains.title_en: 2. Fed Hike Expectations Surge → Strong USD Hits Global Liquidity

nodes.text:
联储官员
警告通胀扩散

jargon.explain: 工厂出厂价格涨多少，是CPI的"上游预告片"。PPI涨意味着几个月后消费者物价可能跟着涨。
jargon.explain_en: How much factory gate prices rise — the 'upstream trailer' for CPI. Rising PPI means consumer prices may follow in coming months.

jargon.explain: 以前只有油价涨，现在服务业、医疗、住房都在涨，说明通胀不是单一原因而是全面蔓延，更难治。
jargon.explain_en: Previously only oil rose; now services, healthcare, housing all rising — inflation is broad-based, harder to fix.

jargon.explain: 最敏感反映"未来1-2年利率预期"的指标。它暴涨说明市场认为美联储还要加息。
jargon.explain_en: Most sensitive indicator of '1-2 year rate expectations.' A surge means markets think the Fed will hike more.

jargon.explain: 两国利率差减去通胀差。日本央行高田创提到市场开始看实际利差，意味着即使日本加息，如果美国通胀更高，日元照样跌。
jargon.explain_en: Interest rate differential minus inflation differential. BOJ's Takata mentioned markets now look at real spreads — even if Japan hikes, higher US inflation means JPY still falls.

chains.title: ③ 中东供应过剩预期 → 原油崩跌 → 黄金失锚链
chains.title_en: 3. Middle East Surplus Expectation → Oil Crash → Gold Unanchored

nodes.text:
中东原油夺回
亚洲市场

jargon.explain: 产油量超过消费量，多余石油只能存进油罐，价格自然下跌。
jargon.explain_en: Production exceeds consumption; excess oil goes into storage, prices naturally fall.

jargon.explain: 沙特等产油国每月公布给不同地区的原油报价。下调至六年低位=主动降价抢客户。
jargon.explain_en: Saudi etc. monthly publish oil prices for different regions. Cutting to 6-year low = proactively cutting prices to grab customers.

jargon.explain: 名义利率减通胀预期。油价跌→通胀预期降→实际利率反而升→持有黄金的机会成本增加→金价跌。这就是为什么油价跌黄金也跌。
jargon.explain_en: Nominal rate minus inflation expectations. Oil falls → inflation expectations drop → real rates rise → gold holding opportunity cost increases → gold falls. This is why oil and gold fall together.

chains.title: ④ 美联储点名AI估值泡沫 → 科技股风险偏好收缩链
chains.title_en: 4. Fed Flags AI Valuation Bubble → Tech Risk Appetite Contracts

nodes.text:
金融稳定报告
点名AI估值

芯片指数-3%
纳指反弹失利

jargon.explain: 美联储每半年发布一次，专门找金融系统的"隐患"。这次把AI资产估值列为"持续高位脆弱性"，等于官方说"你们炒太高了"。
jargon.explain_en: Fed publishes semi-annually to find financial 'vulnerabilities.' This time AI asset valuations flagged as 'persistently elevated fragility' — official way of saying 'you're buying too high.'

jargon.explain: 市场认为AI很快会达到或超越人类智能水平，所以提前给AI公司天价估值。美联储认为这个预期可能过度乐观。
jargon.explain_en: Markets believe AI will soon reach or exceed human intelligence, so pre-price AI companies at sky-high valuations. Fed thinks this may be overly optimistic.

jargon.explain: AI公司投入巨资买芯片建数据中心，如果收入不及预期，资本开支变成沉没成本，股价跌幅会比普通公司更大。
jargon.explain_en: AI companies invest heavily in chips and data centers. If revenue misses, capex becomes sunk cost, stock drops more than ordinary companies.

chains.title: ⑤ 中国10月数据偏弱 → A股成长股杀跌 → 防御切换链
chains.title_en: 5. China Oct Data Weak → A-share Growth Selloff → Defensive Rotation

nodes.text:
银行股创新高
恒指+0.8%（分化）

jargon.term: 社零（社会消费品零售总额）
jargon.explain: 老百姓花了多少钱买东西。+0.4%几乎零增长，剔除汽车后+2.5%说明汽车拖累严重。
jargon.explain_en: How much people spent buying things. +0.4% is near zero; ex-auto +2.5% shows autos dragged heavily.

jargon.explain: 国家统计局解释，今年10月工作日比去年同期少，数据看起来差部分是"日历效应"不是真差。
jargon.explain_en: NBS explains October had fewer working days than last year — data looks worse partly due to 'calendar effect' not real weakness.

jargon.explain: 经济弱时资金从高风险成长股（科技、新能源）流向低风险高股息股（银行、公用事业），叫"防御"。
jargon.explain_en: When economy weak, money flows from high-risk growth (tech, new energy) to low-risk high-dividend (banks, utilities) — called 'defensive.'

jargon.explain: M2是全部存款，M1是活期存款。差收窄说明活钱开始动起来，经济活跃度边际改善的微弱信号。
jargon.explain_en: M2 is total deposits, M1 is demand deposits. Gap narrowing means active money starts moving — weak signal of economic improvement.

chains.title: ⑥ 特朗普AI"国家领军企业"名单 → 出口管制路线之争链
chains.title_en: 6. Trump AI 'National Champion' List → Export Control Route Battle

nodes.text:
与黄仁勋反对
芯片后门冲突

AI管制路线
不确定性上升

jargon.explain: 特朗普政府认证的"信得过"AI公司，卖芯片给海外客户时走绿色通道不用慢慢审批。
jargon.explain_en: Trump admin certifies 'trusted' AI companies — get green channel for overseas chip sales without slow approval.

jargon.explain: 在芯片里装"定位追踪"，卖出去后能监控谁在用、用来干嘛。黄仁勋反对，Anthropic支持，这是路线之争的核心。
jargon.explain_en: Install 'location tracking' in chips — can monitor who uses them and for what after sale. Huang opposes, Anthropic supports — core of the route battle.

jargon.explain: 鲁比奥涉嫌把CIA报告改写后泄露给媒体推动黄仁勋下台；Anthropic被指向记者提供爆料。两者都在推动更严格的芯片管制。
jargon.explain_en: Rubio allegedly rewrote CIA report and leaked to media to push Huang out; Anthropic allegedly provided tips to journalists. Both push stricter chip controls.

chains.title: ⑦ SpaceX-特斯拉合并 + 星舰复用 → 估值范式重塑链
chains.title_en: 7. SpaceX-Tesla Merger + Starship Reuse → Valuation Paradigm Shift

nodes.text:
合并谈判提速
最快12月宣布
nodes.text_en:
Merger talks accelerate
announce as early as Dec

nodes.text:
星舰"双回收"
飞船回收待验证

完全复用
压低入轨成本

jargon.explain: 火箭发射后，助推器（下半截）和飞船（上半截）都要回收重复使用。这次助推器爆炸了，飞船回收待验证。
jargon.explain_en: After launch, both booster (lower half) and spacecraft (upper half) must be recovered and reused. This time booster exploded, spacecraft recovery pending.

jargon.explain: 用发射塔的机械臂像筷子一样夹住降落中的火箭/飞船，不用着陆腿，节省重量和成本。
jargon.explain_en: Use launch tower mechanical arms to catch descending rocket/spacecraft like chopsticks — no landing legs, saves weight and cost.

jargon.explain: 火箭每一部分都能回收再用，就像飞机一样。一旦实现，发射成本可能降低90%以上，是SpaceX万亿估值的核心逻辑。
jargon.explain_en: Every part of rocket recovered and reused, like an airplane. Once achieved, launch costs may drop 90%+ — core logic for SpaceX's trillion-dollar valuation.

jargon.explain: SpaceX（未上市）和特斯拉（上市）合并，将是人类历史上最大并购案，意味着太空资产可借特斯拉上市公司通道变现。
jargon.explain_en: SpaceX (private) and Tesla (public) merger would be the largest in history — space assets can be monetized through Tesla's public listing.

verifications.title: ① 英伟达CEO危机是否会演变为AI capex"急刹车"？
verifications.title_en: 1. Will the Nvidia CEO crisis trigger an AI capex 'hard stop'?
vars: 黄仁勋是否正式复职（关注本周特朗普亚洲行是否提及）
5000亿AI融资平台首笔交易是否在明年1月落地
微软/Meta/亚马逊Q4资本开支指引是否下调
英伟达下季财报数据中心收入环比增速
verifications.analogy_text: 互联网泡沫时思科是"卖铲人"，capex周期逆转后股价跌去80%。
verifications.analogy_text_en: During dot-com bubble, Cisco was the 'shovel seller.' When capex cycle reversed, stock dropped 80%.
verifications.lesson: 教训：当"卖铲人"自身出现领导危机，往往标志着整个capex周期见顶。
verifications.lesson_en: Lesson: When the 'shovel seller' itself has a leadership crisis, it often marks the peak of the entire capex cycle.
verifications.diff: 关键区别：当年思科没有5000亿融资平台这种"兜底机制"，且AI需求有实际收入支撑（非纯预期），崩塌速度可能更慢但修复也可能更快。
verifications.diff_en: Key difference: Cisco had no $500B financing 'safety net,' and AI demand has real revenue support (not pure expectations). Collapse may be slower but recovery could be faster.

verifications.title: ② 强美元是否会引爆新兴市场/日元危机？
verifications.title_en: 2. Will the strong USD trigger an EM/JPY crisis?
vars: 美元/日元能否站稳160上方（日本央行干预阈值）
日本央行12月是否紧急加息（高田创已暗示灵活应对）
美债10年期收益率是否突破5.2%并持续
新兴市场美元债CDS利差是否走阔
verifications.analogy_title: 1997年亚洲金融危机 / 2022年英镑-日元崩跌
verifications.analogy_text: 强美元+美债收益率飙升→资本回流美国→新兴市场货币崩塌。
verifications.analogy_text_en: Strong USD + UST yield surge → capital flows back to US → EM currency collapse.
verifications.lesson: 教训：美元指数突破105并持续3个月以上，新兴市场几乎必然出事。
verifications.lesson_en: Lesson: When Dollar Index exceeds 105 for 3+ months, EM crises are almost inevitable.
verifications.diff: 关键区别：当前日本外储充裕（1.2万亿美元），且日元贬值部分是日本央行默许的（利于出口），与1997年被动贬值不同。但日元破160后日本企业进口成本压力可能倒逼央行急转。
verifications.diff_en: Key difference: Japan has ample reserves ($1.2T), and JPY depreciation is partly BOJ-tolerated (export-friendly), unlike 1997's passive devaluation. But above 160, import cost pressure may force BOJ to pivot.

verifications.title: ③ 油价暴跌是"通胀退烧药"还是"衰退信号"？
verifications.title_en: 3. Is the oil crash an 'inflation cure' or 'recession signal'?
vars: OPEC+是否紧急召开会议讨论减产
美国页岩油钻机数是否开始下降（盈亏平衡线约$65-70）
美国10月CPI能源分项环比变化
高盛/IEA月报是否进一步下调2027需求预测
verifications.analogy_text: 沙特拒绝减产抢市场份额，油价腰斩，一度被视为"消费者红利"，但实际是全球需求放缓的前兆。
verifications.analogy_text_en: Saudi refused to cut production for market share, oil halved — seen as 'consumer dividend' but actually a precursor to global demand slowdown.
verifications.lesson: 教训：油价大跌可以是好事（降通胀），但如果是因为需求塌方导致的，那就是衰退信号而非红利。
verifications.lesson_en: Lesson: Oil price drops can be good (lower inflation), but if caused by demand collapse, it's a recession signal not a dividend.
verifications.diff: 关键区别：本次油价跌的主因是中东供应恢复而非需求崩塌，且高盛明确预测"过剩"而非"需求萎缩"，更接近2014年供给侧冲击。但若叠加AI capex放缓→就业走弱，可能演变为需求端问题。
verifications.diff_en: Key difference: This oil drop is mainly from Middle East supply recovery, not demand collapse. Goldman explicitly forecasts 'surplus' not 'demand shrinkage' — closer to 2014 supply-side shock. But if AI capex slowdown → job weakness, could become demand-side.

verifications.title: ④ 中国经济数据偏弱是"错月扰动"还是"趋势性放缓"？
verifications.title_en: 4. Is China's weak data a 'calendar effect' or 'structural slowdown'?
vars: 11月工业增加值是否反弹（验证"错月"解释）
房地产销售面积环比是否企稳（政策效果验证）
社零中汽车分项是否回升（以旧换新效果）
央行是否推出新的结构性货币政策工具
verifications.analogy_text: 当年7月数据突然走弱，官方解释为"基数效应/季节因素"，但实际是经济进入L型下行通道的开始。
verifications.analogy_text_en: July data suddenly weakened, officials explained as 'base effect/seasonal,' but it was actually the start of L-shaped downturn.
verifications.lesson: 教训：当官方用"技术性因素"解释数据走弱时，至少有一半概率是趋势性问题而非暂时扰动。
verifications.lesson_en: Lesson: When officials use 'technical factors' to explain weak data, there's at least a 50% chance it's structural, not temporary.
verifications.diff: 关键区别：当前信息服务业+20.5%、装备制造业出口+12.5%，结构亮点比2015年明显。但地产投资-21.6%的拖累力度也远超2015年，政策对冲力度需要更大。
verifications.diff_en: Key difference: IT services +20.5%, equipment manufacturing exports +12.5% — structural bright spots clearer than 2015. But property investment -21.6% drag far exceeds 2015, requiring larger policy offset.

verifications.title: ⑤ SpaceX-特斯拉合并是否真的会在12月落地？
verifications.title_en: 5. Will the SpaceX-Tesla merger actually close in December?
vars: SEC是否对跨界合并提出反垄断审查
特斯拉股东大会是否召开投票
SpaceX最新一轮融资估值
星舰飞船回收是否成功（完全复用可行性验证）
verifications.analogy_text: 号称"世纪合并"，互联网泡沫巅峰产物，合并后市值蒸发超80%。
verifications.analogy_text_en: Dubbed 'merger of the century,' peak dot-com bubble product. Post-merger market cap evaporated 80%+.
verifications.lesson: 教训：在估值高点宣布的"世纪合并"，往往成为泡沫顶部标志而非价值创造起点。
verifications.lesson_en: Lesson: 'Century mergers' announced at valuation peaks often mark bubble tops, not value creation starts.
verifications.diff: 关键区别：AOL-时代华纳是纯股票互换、无实体协同；SpaceX-特斯拉有真实技术协同（自动驾驶+卫星通信+能源），且星舰复用若成功有实质成本优势。但监管阻力远大于当年。
verifications.diff_en: Key difference: AOL-TW was pure stock swap with no physical synergy; SpaceX-Tesla has real tech synergy (autonomous driving + satellite comms + energy), and Starship reuse success means real cost advantage. But regulatory阻力 is far greater.
